findings.claim: FY2026 Q4 公司作為原告與 Visa、Mastercard 等就信用卡交換費訴訟達成和解，收到淨額 $24.2M，全數捐予 Ralph Lauren Corporate Foundation；10-K 稱待決事項預期無重大不利影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: During the fourth quarter of Fiscal 2026, we entered into settlement agreements with Visa, Inc., Mastercard Incorporated, and other named parties to resolve credit card interchange fee litigation matters in which we were a plaintiff. As a result of these settlements, we received $24.2 million of cash proceeds, net of legal fees, which were recognized as gains during the fourth quarter of Fiscal 2026.

findings.claim: Kaskela Law 於 2026 年 4 月公告對 Ralph Lauren 股東調查（潛在證券法／受託責任違反），僅為律所徵案，搜尋未見已提起的證券集體訴訟。
